newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED V RAPID VIENNA TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED V RAPID VIENNA TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup match between Manchester United of England and Rapid Vienna of Austria in group C of the Champions' League:

Manchester United: 1-Peter Schmeichel; 2-Gary Neville, 3-Denis Irwin, 5-Ronny Johnsen, 6-Gary Pallister, 7-Eric Cantona, 10-David Beckham, 11-Ryan Giggs, 15-Karel Poborsky, 16-Roy Keane, 20-Ole Solskjaer

Rapid Vienna: 1-Michael Konsel; 4-Trifon Ivanov, 5-Peter Schoettel, 6-Peter Stoeger, 10-Dietmar Kuehbauer, 11-Christian Prosenik, 15-Andrzej Lesiak, 16-Krzystof Ratajczyk, 17-Rene Wagner, 19-Thomas Zingler, 20-Andreas Heraf.
